objects/def_fd9bed6167e4.json.name: Platform
objects/def_fd9bed6167e4.json.description: A square ground tile. Draw rows of them to build platforms.

objects/def_54a46892d722.json.name: Stone
objects/def_54a46892d722.json.description: A square stone tile for walls, ledges and floors.

objects/def_667f740926b0.json.name: Ladder
objects/def_667f740926b0.json.description: A ladder segment. Draw a column of them to make a ladder of any height.

objects/def_e1bb1cbcf4a9.json.name: Enemy
objects/def_e1bb1cbcf4a9.json.description: A basic enemy that hurts on contact and is defeated by jumping on it. It patrols near where it starts (sometimes up or down a ladder) and chases the player once it sees it, slowing down before it turns around.

scripts.name: Stomp
scripts.description: Jumping on it from above defeats it; whoever jumped bounces off unhurt.

scripts.name: Hurts on touch
scripts.description: Touching it hurts player (1 health a hit).

objects/def_014ee1f9884f.json.name: Key
objects/def_014ee1f9884f.json.description: A key to pick up. Doors can require it.

objects/def_b3b7859d937a.json.name: Door
objects/def_b3b7859d937a.json.description: A door that blocks the way until it is opened (by a switch, a key or a rule).

objects/def_100e6515170c.json.name: Switch
objects/def_100e6515170c.json.description: A lever. Press E next to it to flip it. Make it control a door.

objects/def_e38b0104145b.json.name: Hazard
objects/def_e38b0104145b.json.description: Spikes, one tile wide: damages anything that touches it. Draw a row of them for longer spikes.

scripts.name: Hurts on touch
scripts.description: Touching it hurts anything with health (1 health a hit).

objects/def_78f6d48ae134.json.name: Teleporter
objects/def_78f6d48ae134.json.description: A teleporter pad. Connect two with "teleports to" (each way for a two-way pair): stepping on one puts the player on the other.

objects/def_d05b4b1a5808.json.name: Goal
objects/def_d05b4b1a5808.json.description: The level goal: reaching it wins the level (play goes on to the next level).

objects/def_99a409a0126a.json.name: Crate
objects/def_99a409a0126a.json.description: A heavy crate the player can push sideways, slowly (it falls off ledges); stand on it to reach higher.

objects/def_85e7ca5783c2.json.name: Ramp
objects/def_85e7ca5783c2.json.description: A 45 degree ramp rising to the right: walked up and down. Stand it on the ground with the ground going on, level with its top, on its right.

objects/def_f59368fdbc68.json.name: Ramp left
objects/def_f59368fdbc68.json.description: A 45 degree ramp rising to the left: walked up and down. Stand it on the ground with the ground going on, level with its top, on its left.

objects/def_0257b5639c54.json.name: Bridge
objects/def_0257b5639c54.json.description: A plank bridge, a jump-through platform: the player lands on it from above and jumps up through it from below (Down + Jump drops through). Draw rows of it across gaps, level with the ground.

objects/def_2e58a382678c.json.name: Water
objects/def_2e58a382678c.json.description: The surface of water, its waves moving, drawn see-through in front of whoever swims in it: the player swims in it (Jump strokes up) and jumps out at the top. The top row of a pool; Deep water under it.

objects/def_8c9656154e0c.json.name: Deep water
objects/def_8c9656154e0c.json.description: Water under the surface (the Water row): fills a pool below it.

objects/def_66338e0dbdc0.json.name: Spring
objects/def_66338e0dbdc0.json.description: A spring (or a bouncy mushroom, a bubble…) on the floor: a half-jump bounce; holding Jump on it launches the player two jumps high.

scripts.name: Spring
scripts.description: Bounces the player half a jump high, or two jumps high holding Jump. Coming down on it bounces anything with a Character Controller half its jump; holding Jump as the player lands (or pressing it just before or after) launches it twice its jump. Settings: bounce and launch (in the player's own jumps), timing (how close to landing a press of Jump still launches).

do.cond: has_tag(other, "player") and (key("jump") or time - pressed_at < timing)

handlers.if: time < launch_until and pressed("jump") and exists(player)

objects/def_5eb22ea91d9c.json.name: Question block
objects/def_5eb22ea91d9c.json.description: A ? block: jumping up into it from below gives a Coin on top, once. Two empty cells under it.

scripts.name: Question block
scripts.description: Gives a Coin when the player bumps it from below, then shows its used look (SpriteStates.used). times: how many bumps give one.

objects/def_952836f42a5a.json.name: Brick
objects/def_952836f42a5a.json.description: A brick block: jumping up into it from below breaks it.

scripts.name: Brick block
scripts.description: Breaks when the player bumps it from below.

objects/def_35ef8c44338c.json.name: Pipe top
objects/def_35ef8c44338c.json.description: The top of a pipe, two cells wide: on the ground or on Pipe pieces.

objects/def_801482e19354.json.name: Pipe
objects/def_801482e19354.json.description: Pipe going down, two cells wide, under a Pipe top.

objects/def_af16a4e1ccfb.json.name: Heart
objects/def_af16a4e1ccfb.json.description: A heart: picking it up gives back one heart of health (up to the most the player can have). Its look is also the look of the player's hearts on the screen.

objects/def_078b94d9601e.json.name: Pressure plate
objects/def_078b94d9601e.json.description: A pressure plate on the floor: on while the player or a crate stands on it, off when it leaves. Make it control a door: the door is open only while the plate is held down (push a crate onto it to keep it open).

scripts.name: Pressure plate
scripts.description: On while the player or a crate (anything tagged pushable or crate) is on it, off when it leaves: "switch_activated" happens each time, so what it controls opens while it is held down and closes after. Shows its used look (SpriteStates.used) while pressed.
